payload.recallText: A family lives next to the Kennedys and associate themselves with the kennedys going to the same church being of the same religion and heritage.  Every summer the aunts would take the children to nantucket where they were right next to the kennedy compound and while the kids played on the beach the aunts set up surviellance of the kenndys making note of who was there who visiited and told stories about the kennedys all day.  One day they were watching and not paying attention to the children and the children found a half inflated boat that they climbed into and got swept out to sea.  Their rescuers were 2 of the kennedys
